rowText.steps: Same question as NOTES-BLOCK-01. A poll on the page every 300 ms from the moment Ask was pressed, returning the first moment the block existed together with the length of the reply text at that moment.
rowText.expected: The block is on screen before the reply starts streaming, not only when it completes.

buildOnDeck: the tip deployed 2026-09-18 (6d5b83f plus generated files)
reads: First poll after the press (145 ms after the poll started, a few seconds after Ask): the block already existed with header 'Starting out in Pikmin 2 · From the Pikmin wiki (+2 more)', the reply text length was 0, and the reply's action row did not exist yet. The model's thinking fold then ran about 16 seconds before the first word.
When the reply completed about 15 seconds later the same header was still there, unchanged: no flicker, no re-mount, the handoff from the live snapshot to the finished one was invisible.

rerun_2026-09-18_after_the_fixes.question: How do I lose the wanted level in GTA 3? (nothing running, library 2026.09.18)
rerun_2026-09-18_after_the_fixes.timeline: a poll every second from the press: the block present at every read from the first second, with no reply text for 25 seconds of thinking, then the reply growing from 81 to 1058 characters over 12 seconds, the block present throughout, and still there when the action row appeared
rerun_2026-09-18_after_the_fixes.counterexample: the Super Smash Bros. question a few minutes earlier: no block at the moment the action row appeared, block present a few seconds later; the tip row (NOTES-BLOCK-03) showed the same late arrival. So the live path holds on most turns and misses on some, both a game note and a tip; the lane has both examples

verdict: PASS with an intermittent miss recorded
verdictSentence: The block is on screen before the model's first word and stays through the reply, proven by a per-second timeline; on one game question in ten and on the tip question it arrived only after the reply finished.
